new_probes.command: Two evaluator-reported inline rtk python probes, normalized to one-line reproductions in artifacts/evaluator-initial-revise.txt
new_probes.oracle: With zero continuation references, tool_result_read is absent from allowed and deferred sets and direct activation is denied.
new_probes.anti_oracle: tool_result_read appears in both sets and tool_activate returns tool_activated.

findings: tool_result_read could be activated without any actual continuation reference because continuation state was not part of the fallback-safety contract.
